label: HEURISTIC_HO

reference_common.info_contract: Random/Dynamic A/R only. Dynamic common role planning uses shared delayed actor report; each own movement uses only that UAV's current self state. No actual UE positions/current fleet census/reward/future rollout enters controller.
reference_common.explanation_contract: True-state diagnostic logging occurs after action execution only. Demand waterfall is fixed-snapshot accounting; bandwidth probes are sparse isolated what-if radio calculations, not causal energy ablations or benchmark parameter changes.
reference_common.trace_hash_contract: SHA256 chain: H0=32 zero bytes; Ht=SHA256(Ht-1 || service-time UE positions float64 little endian C order)
reference_common.scope: Frozen checkpoints; no training or best reselection on test. Pilot is separate from ten held-out test traces. One training seed per learned arm; seed-wise paired scenario results do not measure training-seed variability.

information_contract: Exactly the existing delayed 130D shared report; each local movement uses only its own current 7D self state. Every Active UAV is H. No true UEs/current peer states/reward/future rollout.
controller_contract: One fixed all-H role vector; one-step TCF estimates on the same synthetic UE belief as Dynamic A/R; legal 5-move search; same unknown-map exploration and zero-score chain navigation with all H.
scope: Post-hoc additional baseline after examining six-arm test results; no retuning per test seed, no old checkpoint/science changes; same locked scenario seeds.
